
        <h2 class="post-title">
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jiazhengjing/p/19992897" title="发布于 2026-05-08 11:22">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">RV1126B 适配gc2093启动HDR</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>内核版本：6.1</p>
<p>文件系统：ubuntu22.04</p>
<h1>1、具体问题</h1>
<p>　　客户要gc2093支持hdr功能，后续提供iq文件只支持hdr模式,发现默认没有启动hdr功能</p>
<h1>2、调试过程及遇到问题</h1>
<h2>2.1 确认RV1126b支持hdr模式</h2>
<p>　　查阅rv1126b数据手册确认支持HDR_X2</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="1210" height="676" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508091537189-311047060.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>2.2 设备树配置启动HDR</h2>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u4238a688" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查阅include/uapi/linux/rk-camera-module.h</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508100943290-1102295824.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　在设备树中添加该配置</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>rockchip,camera-hdr-mode = &lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>&gt;;</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508101019886-677443863.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　在gc2093驱动中添加打印信息定位是否启动生效</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508101348241-428062250.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　　　烧写固件后确认设备树配置生效，但是v4l2抓图会卡住，发现会被rkaiq_3A_server 启动后覆盖掉了</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508105532420-1796775333.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　　　查阅rkaiq_3A_server源码，发现默认配置并不支持切换场景。默认跑iq文件的normal</p>
<p>　　　　源码路径:external/camera_engine_rkaiq/rkaiq_3A_server/rkaiq_3A_server.cpp</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508105819199-103795520.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　　&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 由于使用iq文件只有hdr场景，如下图所示，修改rkaiq_3A_server.cpp （这里测试过imx415 iq是支持normal和hdr场景，直接配置rkaiq_3A_server切换为hdr模式即可）</p>
<p>　　　　1、先<span class="ne-text">使用rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_preInit_scene切换到hdr场景，</span></p>
<p><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;　　　　2、再使用</span>rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_prepare这个是用于切换模式的。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508110127889-407429237.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;　　这里将场景固定为RK_AIQ_WORKING_MODE_ISP_HDR2</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> init_engine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> rkaiq_media_info *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">media_info)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> index;
    rk_aiq_working_mode_t  work_mode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RK_AIQ_WORKING_MODE_ISP_HDR2;
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (work_mode){
        rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_preInit_scene(media_info</span>-&gt;sensor_entity_name, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hdr</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">day</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ERR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rkaiq engine prepare mode0x%x   main_scene: hdr,   sub_scene:day  !\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,work_mode);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
          rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_preInit_scene(media_info</span>-&gt;sensor_entity_name, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">normal</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">day</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ERR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rkaiq engine prepare mode0x%x   main_scene: normal, sub_scene:day !\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,work_mode);
    }

    media_info</span>-&gt;aiq_ctx = rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_init(media_info-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sensor_entity_name,
                                                  IQ_PATH, NULL, NULL);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3A server has listened stream events already </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_setListenStrmStatus(media_info</span>-&gt;aiq_ctx, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (has_mul_cam)
        rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_setMulCamConc(media_info</span>-&gt;aiq_ctx, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_prepare(media_info-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aiq_ctx,
            width, height, work_mode)) {
        ERR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rkaiq engine prepare failed !\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        exit(</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; 修改后重新编译rkaiq_3a_server,再启动3a_server,成功启动hdr功能</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508111113858-1466463854.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp; 3、总结</p>
<p>　　原厂指南也有这部分说明，只是一句话带过，具体需要以iq文件为准，实现顺序是先切摄像头场景，再切模式。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260508111958731-153429205.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
